description: Support URL and feedback Typeform configuration per distribution, and the feedback dialog opened from help menus, topbar, and agent surfaces. It reuses the surveys Typeform dialog.

characterizationScenarios.name: Feedback and support links carry the source and distribution and open the feedback dialog

compatibilityPromises: Unclassified callers may import these internals during inventory; imports from classified domains remain subject to cross-domain rules.
openFeedbackDialog remains callable from help center, topbar, cloud feedback button, and agent feedback callers.
feedbackDialog reusing openTypeformDialog from surveys and reading the current user remains visible as cross-domain coupling; classification does not grant dependency exceptions.
